rationale: A defensible but purely mechanical merge of two already-tested gen-8 variants whose parents perform almost identically, so the incremental information is small, and the payload — (ib − Δceq − Δdebt), i.e. net distributions to all claimants — remains a close relative of the published net-external-financing/total-payout anomaly conditioned on value, which limits novelty even if the test is worth one run.

Intersecting two highly correlated market-cap-scaled cheapness gates is a conditioning/threshold tweak rather than a new economic mechanism, and because sales/P and B/P share the same denominator the intersection will largely reproduce either parent while further thinning an already coverage-constrained (0.109) sample.

This is a data-handling robustness check on the deflator, not a cross-theme signal; the coverage gain over the parent is modest (~0.109 → ~0.14 at best), and COALESCE(xsga,0) silently changes the deflator's economic meaning across reporting regimes, so a "surviving" result is as likely to reflect deflator heterogeneity as genuine breadth.

The sustainability condition is economically coherent and gating rather than rank-averaging is the right response to the earlier SUMRANK dilution, but stacking a second 0.5 gate on top of a 0.6 gate within an already sparse sample risks unstable extreme portfolios, so coverage and turnover diagnostics must be checked before crediting any alpha improvement.

This is the one proposal that asks a genuine structural question — whether the shareholder-payout and debt-retirement legs are additive or complementary — and the MIN construction is not reproducible by the existing sum, so the result is informative regardless of sign; it is distinct from the earlier CheapCashBackedCapitalReturn, which paired the combined flow with operating cash flow instead.

The stated sign contradicts the expression: the payload is high when a firm *returns* capital and low when it *absorbs* it, so the hypothesis ("capital absorbers underperform") implies a positive slope, not the declared negative one, and beyond this inconsistency the design is a sign-flipped gate on an already-tested payload.
